issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency for the forward QFT method: the template class QFTNQubit declares a method named _qft_circuit_n_qubits(self, qc: QuantumCircuit) while the solution implements qft_circuit_n_qubits(self, qc: QuantumCircuit) (no leading underscore). The problem statement's Exercise 7 refers to implementing the QFT for n qubits (task names imply a public qft_circuit_n_qubits API). This mismatch can confuse students about which method name to implement and can break automated tests/autograders that expect the non-underscored public method qft_circuit_n_qubits.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across artifacts. Rename the template method _qft_circuit_n_qubits to qft_circuit_n_qubits so the template, solution, and problem statement use the same public method name. Alternatively, update tests and the solution to call the underscored name, but prefer exposing qft_circuit_n_qubits (no leading underscore) in the template to match the exercise wording and the solution implementation.

issues.description: Concept: forward Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) implementation for an arbitrary number of qubits. Problem statement / tests reference the task for implementing QFT on an n-qubit QuantumCircuit (task id test_ex2_qft_circuit_n_qubits) and the solution implements a public method named qft_circuit_n_qubits(self, qc). Template: the template class defines the forward QFT method with an extra leading underscore as _qft_circuit_n_qubits(self, qc). Mismatch: template exposes _qft_circuit_n_qubits while solution and task identifiers use qft_circuit_n_qubits. Why this is confusing/impactful: students following the template may implement or call the underscored name; automated tests or graders that expect qft_circuit_n_qubits will not find the implementation, causing failures unrelated to the algorithm. This is an identifier naming inconsistency for the same conceptual entity (forward QFT).
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template method from _qft_circuit_n_qubits to qft_circuit_n_qubits to match the solution and the task/test naming (or update the problem text/tests to reference the underscored name). Ensure both forward and inverse QFT method names are consistent across problem statement, template, and tests (e.g., qft_circuit_n_qubits and qft_circuit_n_qubits_inverse).
